custom_logic_notes: The Alligator indicator determines market state: when Jaw, Teeth, and Lips are intertwined ('sleeping'), no trades are taken. When they spread apart ('eating'), the trend direction is determined by the order of the lines. Entry requires Lips crossing above/below Teeth while all three lines are properly aligned (Lips > Teeth > Jaw for long, Lips < Teeth < Jaw for short). Previous bar values [1] are used for crossover detection (comparing current vs previous bar). Digit adjustment is applied to SL/TP values by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use ta-library or manual SMMA calculation for Alligator (SMMA is exponential Wilder smoothing). Three SMMA lines with different periods (13,8,5) and forward shifts (8,5,3). Crossover detection on previous completed bar. Digit adjustment for SL/TP pip values needed for 5-digit brokers. No external dependencies. Position management is simple: close opposite on signal reversal, one position at a time per direction.
